notes.title: Soundtrack, FPS Update, New Visuals
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963255/3b184af7e7524c3aa6d6c6e09ea5b7c850cde575.png

October 22nd 2024 - I've been listening to all the feedback and fixing as much as I can / as fast as I can.

So Here's a little update of whats going on

Keyboard and mouse

Right now keyboard and mouse is just a long demo. Experience what people get to experience in virtual reality... on keyboard and mouse. The first few levels have weapons, enemies, and clues hidden around the maps. You'll have to find your way through the levels like a maze / backrooms experience.

Virtual Reality

There's been a lot of little things added to make the player have a smoother time. Here's some of them

- Added 96000 bit rate WAV audio files in game so player can have the highest quality audio horror experience
- Added optimized reverb zones so player can feel as immersed as possible
- More Audio cues that will signal the player where to go
- Better A.I. Detection
- more weapons scattered around the map
- melee weapons scattered around the map
- Added more lights so the game isn't as dark
- Simplified and improved functionality of the u.i. menu when you press the secondary button on the left controller
- Added more voice overs to give the game more context / story
- Added a layer of fog, dust, and leaves.
- Added more creepy features / effects
- Fixed movement and grabbable sticks / items in "Hockey Mini-Sticks VR", everything should be function like the standalone game exclusively to Meta Quest
- Increased boss enemies health.
- Increased FPS through GPU Instanced Draws from Unity 6
- Smoothed out the swing of the crow bar
- Added blood gushes when you stab enemies with swords

Working on:
Saving Functionality
long loading screens that make it looks like the game is broken
Offline & Online Escape Room bugs
Bosses not doing damage to the player glitch
Continue to improve audio quality

notes.title: OCT 13 PATCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
New updates on steam and quest

- new day house puzzle fix / update
- bosses fix now actually detect character 
- added bosses, hid weapons and a bunch of swords from Invictus around the first town
- fixed problem where witches weren’t detecting enemies or moving on nav mesh
- fixed movement and detection of mini demon children that chompy the dog boss summons
- added more environmental sounds adding depth to the game
- added GPUinstanced drawing to help back end processing on quest headsets to increase the frame rate. 
- increased resolution, because I’ve used instanced drawing I can now raise the resolution to take advantage of the freed up memory (from 0.34 to 0.7)
- fixed escape rooms glitch where 2 giant flashlights were breaking the scene 
- added more enemies to first escape room and increased their health
- added death and damage sound effects(enemies will make a gush sound when they die)
- added more voice overs to make the player feel less lost(more still need to be added)
- slight reduced the dirtiness filter on the camera to increase clarity and be able to see these graphics
